create.name: Zoe Kanat
create.bio:
Zoe Kanat is a Melbourne-based teacher of yoga nidra and rest practices. Her path began in community and family support work, including years as a counsellor with the perinatal charity PANDA, and she went on to study soul-centred psychotherapy and to earn a diploma in teaching meditation. She later trained in tantric meditation with Tracee Stanley and in Karen Brody's Daring to Rest method, where she now mentors and trains new facilitators. From 2019 to 2023 she sat on the national council of the Meditation Association of Australia, and she keeps a yearly practice of silent insight retreats.

Her teaching treats rest as a skill worth learning rather than a reward saved for later. She has recorded guided yoga nidra and meditation on Insight Timer since 2016, and her own website carries downloadable practices and a ten-day course on finding steadiness in a busy life. She also runs a free monthly online rest gathering that mixes a short practice with story and reflection, and a seasonal live series of morning meditations that follows the moon from new to full. Her tone is quiet and unhurried, with an emphasis on softening, ritual and everyday presence.

courses.title: Restoring Inner Balance In A Fast-Paced World (Digital Course)
courses.description: A ten-part audio course with a short lesson and guided practice each day, covering grounding, pausing and mindful walking. It ends with help shaping a daily routine that fits your own life.

courses.title: Bone Deep Relaxation ~ Yoga Nidra
courses.description: A downloadable yoga nidra that moves attention through body, breath and the play of opposites. It closes with time to return to a personal intention, or sankalpa.

courses.title: Yoga Nidra for Caregivers
courses.description: A yoga nidra recording made for people who look after others, at work or at home. Gentle body awareness and imagery give the listener a stretch of time simply to rest.

courses.title: Tending To The Heart
courses.description: A guided heart-centred meditation to download. Breath awareness and visualisation are used to grow a feeling of warmth and kindness and then share it outward.

courses.title: Gentle Mornings
courses.description: A live fourteen-day series of early meditations on Zoom, running from the new moon to the full moon, with recordings and daily readings. It returns from time to time and has a wait list between rounds.

courses.title: Sacred Living - From Mundane To Magic
courses.description: A five-day Insight Timer course on bringing presence and a sense of the sacred into ordinary days. Story, self-inquiry and short rest practices lead up to making a personal ritual and altar.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Returning To The Heart Of Meditation
courses.description: A seven-day Insight Timer course of short daily sessions for anyone wanting to refresh their sitting practice. Each day looks at one doorway in, such as the body, breath, feelings or intuition.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Zoe Kanat on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Hundreds of free guided yoga nidra and rest meditations recorded since 2016, alongside her paid courses. Free to listen in the app or browser.

free_resources.title: Free Monthly Short Rest Gathering
free_resources.description: A free live online session held once a month through Insight Timer. Each one pairs a short guided rest with story, reflection and simple ritual, and is not recorded.
